<thought>Assuming the two resistors are in series (most common simple topology) and one resistor is twice the other, we solve  R + 2R = 6.667 Ω → R ≈ 2.222 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.445 Ω. The series layout connects A to an intermediate node N1 via R1, then N1 to X1 via R2.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.222, "R2": 4.445}, "connections": [["A","N1","R1"], ["N1","X1","R2"]]}</final_answer>
